critique.evidence: The headline, subtitle, metric definitions, constrained-FPR recall values, measured ablation takeaway, and “Compare configurations” button establish a recognizable claim and action across viewports. However, the precision-recall chart is not independently readable: its x-axis repeats “100%” and ends at “65%,” while the mobile FPR chart retains an obstructive tooltip. “Fresh-row D recall” is undefined, the ablation “delta” says “no change” despite changing PR-AUC because it apparently refers to another column, and the next action appears only after a long mobile scroll. The sticky navigation also overlays chart content on tablet.
critique.fix: Repair and clearly tick the precision-recall axes, remove persistent tooltips, define “Fresh-row D,” label the ablation delta with the metric it measures, and connect each headline metric to its operating constraint. Keep a visible, non-overlapping “Compare configurations” action near the summary and state what comparison it opens.
